description: This file defines the HomeScreen composable in a Kotlin Android project using Jetpack Compose. It displays a list of saved Profiles with UI components like Scaffold, FloatingActionButton, and ProfileCard. It includes preview functions for light and dark themes, as well as a sample data provider.

classes.name: SampleProfilesProvider
classes.description: A preview parameter provider supplying sample Profile data for Compose previews.

methods.name: HomeScreen
methods.description: Main composable function displaying the list of Profiles with a floating action button.

methods.name: ProfileCard
methods.description: A private composable displaying individual Profile details inside an ElevatedCard.

methods.name: SampleProfilesProvider
methods.description: Provides sample Profiles for UI preview.

methods.name: HomePreviewLight
methods.description: Previews the HomeScreen in light theme.

methods.name: HomePreviewDark
methods.description: Previews the HomeScreen in dark theme.
